state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper proposes MAD-Conformist (an agent keeps its answer if it matched the previous round's majority) and MAD-Follower (an agent adopts the previous majority answer with 30% probability, otherwise samples anew), and reports that both consistently outperform vanilla MAD but do not reach the oracle's upper bound.
title: MAD-Conformist and MAD-Follower, guided by the majority vote, beat vanilla debate
